[[Universitario de Deportes|Universitario]] | continentalcup2 =[[Copa CONMEBOL]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers =[[Alianza Lima]] | league topscorer = [[Julinho (footballer, born 1965)|Julinho]] (23 goals) | prevseason = [[1994 Torneo Descentralizado|1994]] | nextseason = [[1996 Torneo Descentralizado|1996]] }} The '''1995 [[Torneo Descentralizado]]''' was the 80th season of the top flight of Peruvian football. A total of 16 teams competed in the tournament. The season began on March 4 and concluded on December 27 with the victory of [[Universitario de Deportes]] over [[Alianza Lima]] for the second berth to the [[1996 Copa Libertadores]]. [[Sporting Cristal]] successfully defended its national title after finishing 12 points ahead of Alianza Lima and Universitario.[https://clubsportingcristal.pe/historia/19-historia/campeones/113-campeon-1995 Sporting Cristal campeón 1995][https://www.gloriosoceleste.com/2019/07/30/campana-sporting-cristal-1995/ Campaña Sporting Cristal 1995][https://www.rsssf.org/tablesp/peru95.html Rsssf.org Peru 1995] ==Changes from 1994== *Torneo Apertura was removed; Torneo Descentralizado immediately began and played on a home-and-away basis between the 16 clubs. *The Octagonal was played at the end of the season with the 8 best-placed teams of the first phase. *In the Octagonal, the 8 clubs played a further 14 rounds to determine the national champion and the berths to the Copa Libertadores and Copa CONMEBOL. == Teams == ===Team changes=== {| class="wikitable" |- !
